value.rationale: The theorem completely classifies a naturally constrained second-best intervention: privatizing only a new shortcut link while original routes remain untolled. It gives exact toll design, delay externality, paradox persistence and the contrast with the socially optimal one-link instrument. The distinction matters because unrestricted all-path monopoly theory gives the opposite policy intuition; the exact all-demand regime boundaries and maximum quantify the divergence. This is a motivated finite-graph canonical benchmark, not an arbitrary parameter slice.
